model.name: roberta-base
model.revision_note: Pinned to the roberta-base snapshot already present in the project Hugging Face cache, which is the revision that produced the earlier unpinned pilot artifacts. The weights are therefore unchanged; only the recorded contract changes. Because architecture_contract() embeds 'revision', pinning necessarily invalidates the unpinned pilot's saved initialization digest, so pinned runs use a separate output root and a fresh shared initialization. The unpinned pilot is retained untouched under results/raw/transformer/.

preregistration.selection: capacity is experimental condition; not validation-selected

unlearning.objective: min_theta L_retain(theta; S) - lambda L_forget(theta; N minus S) + gamma mean_p ||theta_p-theta_full,p||_2^2, optimized only over LoRA and classification-head parameters. This is approximate unlearning, not certified unlearning.
